item.title: Deconstruction starts at Garden Oaks Theater as preservation group urges action
item.description: Deconstruction is underway at the historic Garden Oaks Theater in Houston. The 1947 landmark was sold in October, and preservation group Arthouse Houston continues efforts to save it.
